stories.title: Independent investigative team completes re-investigation of police shooting of Josh Musselman
stories.summary: The case was reopened in October at the request of Spokane County Prosecutor Preston McCollam.

stories.title: 'Foreseeable assault': Family of high schooler attacked by another student in 2024 suing Mead School District
stories.summary: The family claims Mt. Spokane High School staff knew about threats against the teen, but failed to stop a beating that left him with a traumatic brain injury.

stories.title: Here's what's closed in Spokane on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Spokane city services, including City Hall and public libraries, will close on Nov. 26-27 for Thanksgiving, with adjusted schedules for waste collection and events.

stories.title: Boundary County School District gets perfect score on annual audit
stories.summary: The annual state-required audit, conducted by Moscow-based firm Hayden Ross, PLCC, found no discrepancies or internal-control issues.

stories.title: Coeur d'Alene's Tony Mills joins documentary on grizzlies and coexistence
stories.summary: Mills' years of fieldwork as a bow hunter and wildlife photographer have given him invaluable experience with grizzlies.

stories.title: Seattle Public Schools pressures court to pause ban on trans athletes in girls’ sports
stories.summary: Seattle Public Schools filed a legal brief on Wednesday night in support of preventing Initiative 638 from taking effect.

stories.title: Spokane Helpers Network giving back this holiday season by delivering meal kits to local families in need
stories.summary: A local nonprofit that started during the COVID-19 pandemic continues to meet the needs of food-insecure families who can't reach food banks.

stories.title: Hundreds of first responders gather in Spokane to honor fallen deputies Mason Acheson and Parker Perry
stories.summary: Beyond the ceremonial traditions, the service offered a glimpse into the lives of two men who were husbands, fathers, friends and members of their communities.

stories.title: Man sentenced for stabbing and killing a man in downtown Spokane
stories.summary: 21-year-old Colin Pedro will spend 20 years in prison for stabbing and killing a man who intervened in a fight between Pedro and his boyfriend in August 2025.

stories.title: Watch: Full procession, memorial service honoring Spokane Deputies Mason Acheson & Parker Perry
stories.summary: The memorial began at 3 p.m. following a procession from the Spokane County Fairgrounds.

stories.title: Trial set after man pleads innocent in fatal shooting
stories.summary: Shawn Webster, 21, entered the plea during an arraignment hearing Tuesday to a felony charge for the death of resident Jason Sparks in mid-July.

stories.title: Kootenai County median-home price hits $570K
stories.summary: According to the Coeur d'Alene Regional Realtors, the median price of a single-family home in Kootenai County in October rose 4.2% from a year ago.
